name: @w6w-apps/justcall
description: Read and manage JustCall calls, texts, contacts, phone numbers, users and webhooks.

w6w.longDescription:
JustCall is a cloud phone system and SMS/calling platform: phone numbers, agents, calls and text messages in one account. This app covers the core of a JustCall-driven workflow — read and update calls, send and read SMS, manage contacts (including DND/DNM/blacklist status), read phone numbers and their capabilities, look up and update user availability, and manage webhook subscriptions.

The API answers most reads with a paginated envelope (`status`, `data`, `count`, `next_page_link`) and a few writes with a bare `{status}` or a single-item `data` array rather than a single object — every action here follows the shape JustCall's own OpenAPI document declares for that specific endpoint, not a single assumed shape for the whole app.

Health is tracked against JustCall's own Statuspage, which names a genuine `Developer APIs` component distinct from the dashboard and calling infrastructure, plus the account's own hourly and per-minute rate-limit headroom read from the documented `X-Rate-Limit-*` response headers.
